Beings with the disability Detached Psyche may use this ability to possess physical forms bereft of a Spirit and Soul. To initiate possession, a Control Resistance must be made; if it is failed, the being may never possess that form at any time. Once in possession of a form, the Detached Psyche can manipulate and control it, with a penalty of -1 or -5% to all physical actions and physical effects for the first 30 minutes (minus 1 minute per Will Force). Duration and cost of possession varies with the type of form possessed: 1) Mindless Husk: This is the physical body of a being that has died, but whose Mind or Spirit still remain within the body due to Mental Slavery or a Ritual. A Detached Psyche may possess this form for 1 week per Will Force point, and after each week must make a Control Resistance (with a cumulative -5% modifier for each week) or be permanently rejected. 2) Humanoid Corpse: This is the physical body of a being that has died, losing its Mind, Spirit and Soul. When the Detached Psyche initiates possession of a corpse, it is -5% to its Control Resistance for each hour the being has been dead. A Detached Psyche may possess this form for 1 day per natural Will Force point, and after each day must make a Control Resistance (with a cumulative -5% modifier for each day) or be permanently rejected. 3) Animal Corpse: When the Detached Psyche initiates possession of an animal corpse, it is -5% to its Control Resistance for each 10 minutes the animal has been dead. A Detached Psyche may possess this form for 10 minutes per Will Force point, and after each 10 minutes must make a Control Resistance (with a cumulative -5% modifier for each 10 minutes) or be permanently rejected.
